senses.gloss: (b. h.; Shaf. of זף , v. זָפַף a. זֶפֶת) to blacken, tarnish.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:6:3">Cant. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>כך אנו … שְׁזָפַתְנוּ</he> so it is with us, when the sun of idolatry blackened us (we may become white again); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 982">Yalk. ib. 982</cite>.—Part. pass. <he>שָׁזוּף</he>; pl. <he>שְׁזוּפִים</he>. Cant. R. l. c. <he>אבל אתם ש׳ וכ׳</he> but you (gentile idolaters) are black (soiled by idolatry) from your mother’s womb.
